newsitem.title: JAPAN: POLL-Japan June leading index seen at 35 or 40.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Japan June leading index seen at 35 or 40.

text.p: Japan's diffusion index of leading economic indicators in June is likely to come in at 35 or 40 on a scale of 100, compared with a preliminary 33.3 in May, private research firms said on Friday.
The May index of leading indicators is expected to be revised upward to 40 or 50.
A leading indicator reading below the so-called "boom-or-bust" mark of 50 is generally taken as suggesting that the economy will contract in the coming months.
Daiwa Bank Research Institute said the index of coincident indicators, which measures prevailing economic conditions, is expected to fall to 70 in June from 75 in May.
Nikko Research, Yamaichi Research, and Sakura Securities expect the leading index to stand at 35. Nikko and Yamaichi forecast 70 for the coincident index while Sakura predicts 50.
